_doc: LORENZO dating cabinet (#51, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #29). The Gallarate (Varese) mass-market cult brand: Fratelli Lana 1900 -> Tagliabue 1946 -> THE 1969 RENAME to LORENZO PIPES (the wordmark floor) -> 1983 Tagliabue retires (Comoy's/Cadogan license interlude) -> 1988 ALIVERTI family buys the trademark, production resumes. ⚠️ MODERN TRAP: cheaper current lines are ALBANIAN-made (Tomori). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Lorenzo.json (detailed).

history_anchors._doc: 1900: FRATELLI LANA founded, Gallarate (3rd Varese maker after Rossi 1886 + Ceresa 1897 — rossi.json ecosystem). 1922: Tagliabue (Milan merchants) co-operation; exports grow; 1939 = 120 workers. Budget mass pipes, many unmarked beyond 'Genuine Bruyere' (generic-wordmark trap, same rule as Rossi). 1946: Tagliabue takes over -> MANUFATTURA DI PIPE TAGLIABUE. ~1950: LORENZO TAGLIABUE manages; studies Castello/Brebbia; new own-style models, upmarket shift. 1969: brand renamed LORENZO PIPES (another Tagliabue firm existed). The 70s-80s CULT: beefy thick walls, flat sitting bottoms, silk-matte patina in bold red/orange, big Oom Pauls; 'made for real men with strong hands'; student-culture icon; generous putty fills(!). SPITFIRE = budget sister brand (1:1 Lorenzo models, mostly 9mm + smaller classics); LLOYD'S = strictly a second. 1983: Lorenzo Tagliabue's daughter dies; he retires 1983; brand licensed briefly to COMOY'S OF LONDON (Cadogan/Oppenheimer); near-disappearance; Tagliabue dies 1987. 1988: RICCARDO ALIVERTI + Gabriella buy all rights from the family — production resumes (Aliverti lineage: Romolo joined Lana 1920, technical director; Riccardo from 1954, technical director 1973; son Massimo sales director 1991+). MODERN SPLIT: Italian-made better lines (One Star/Two Star/Three Star, Moscato, Spumante, Grand Canadian) vs ALBANIAN-made cheap lines by Tomori (New Era Riesling/Poggio, Angera, Cadry, Churchwarden, Filtro, Arena, Cadore, Sport PS, Garden).

brand_marks.physical: LORENZO + model/number; 70s-80s tells: thick beefy walls, flat bottoms, silk-matte red/orange staining, visible putty fills. Pre-1969 Tagliabue-era pipes rarely say Lorenzo.

line_years._notes: new era/moscato/spumante = Aliverti-era catalog names -> floor 1988 approx (line-level intro years unknown; LOW-leaning). Spitfire/Lloyd's = 70s-80s cult era but undated edges -> aliases only. Star grades unencoded (span).
